class PalindromeProcessor {
    PalindromeProcessor() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        char[] word = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        int[] vals = readInts(br, n);
        int[] badones = new int[26];
        int m = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (word[i] == word[n - i - 1]) {
                badones[word[i] - 'a']++;
                m++;
            }
        }
        int maxCount = 0;
        boolean hasBad = false;
        int badCharIndex = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            if (badones[i] * 2 > m) {
                hasBad = true;
                badCharIndex = i;
            }
        }
        if (!hasBad) {
            long totalSum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1]) {
                    totalSum += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1];
                } else {
                    totalSum += Math.max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]);
                }
            }
            pw.println(totalSum);
        } else {
            int others = badones[badCharIndex] - (m - badones[badCharIndex]);
            List<Integer> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1] && word[i] != ('a' + badCharIndex) && word[n - i - 1] != ('a' + badCharIndex)) {
                    candidates.add(Math.min(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]));
                }
            }
            Collections.sort(candidates);
            long answer = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (word[i] == word[n - i - 1]) {
                    answer += Math.max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]);
                } else {
                    answer += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < others && i < candidates.size(); i++) {
                answer -= candidates.get(i);
            }
            pw.println(answer);
        }
        pw.close();
    }

    private int[] readInts(BufferedReader br, int n) throws IOException {
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return res;
